name: Pentamorphone
summary: Pentamorphone (14β-pentylaminomorphinone, RX-77989) is a semi-synthetic opiate derivative related to compounds such as Morphinone and oxymorphone. Developed in 1984, it is a potent opioid analgesic several times stronger than fentanyl, and with a similarly fast onset of effects and short duration of action.

pharmacology.text: It was found to produce relatively little respiratory depression compared to other potent opioid agonists, but its analgesic effects were somewhat disappointing in human trials, and while pentamorphone had some slight advantages over fentanyl these were not sufficient to warrant its introduction into clinical use.

uses.en: It was studied as a hospital painkiller and was never marketed.
uses.zh: 它曾被研究作為醫院止痛藥，最終未上市。
uses.zhHans: 它曾被研究作为医院止痛药，最终未上市。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the opioids, cause drowsiness, nausea, constipation and slowed breathing, and an overdose can stop breathing altogether.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它所屬的鴉片類藥物會造成嗜睡、噁心、便祕與呼吸變慢，過量時可能導致呼吸完全停止。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它所属的鸦片类药物会造成嗜睡、恶心、便秘与呼吸变慢，过量时可能导致呼吸完全停止。

fact.en: Developed in 1984, it was reported to depress breathing relatively little for its strength, which was the hope behind a whole generation of 14-substituted morphinones.
fact.zh: 它在 1984 年研發，據報告以其強度而言對呼吸的抑制相對較輕，而這正是整整一代 14 位取代嗎啡酮類化合物所寄望的目標。
fact.zhHans: 它在 1984 年研发，据报告以其强度而言对呼吸的抑制相对较轻，而这正是整整一代 14 位取代吗啡酮类化合物所寄望的目标。
